questions.question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"She is cooking dinner."

options.text: Dinner has been cooked by her.
Dinner is being cooked by her.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "She is cooking dinner."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "dinner" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "is cooking" to "is being cooked" (present continuous passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "her."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Dinner is being cooked by her."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Dinner has been cooked by her." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"Dinner was cooked by her." – Incorrect tense (past simple passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"Dinner is cooked by her." – Incorrect tense (simple present passive).
